The '''''Cardan I''-class space station''' was the first model of [[Cardan-class space station|''Cardan''-class]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] built for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
These stations had initial success in maintaining the peace and protecting rimward Imperial [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the aftermath of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but were frequently taken over by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and criminal groups, forcing [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] to produce more heavily armed and protected models.

==Armament==
The ''Cardan I'' was only lightly armed with two light [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries and two light point-defense [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. To assist defense, they also carried a squadron of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and two shuttles.

==Purpose==
The ''Cardan I'' could hold off small [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and starfighters, and sometimes accompanied defense with [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]]-sized capital ships, [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carriers]], and other small ships of their own.

==Construction options==
The ''Cardan I'' was able to produce [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]]. These starfighters could be built in limited numbers, and only one squadron could actually be stored in the hangar of the space station.
